column1: # lee1813: William Lee's WINCHESTER cipher, Paris, February 1813 (see key.md for the rule, the slips and how the key was obtained).
# Tableau: one row per keyword position (0-9); the cell under numeral n is the plaintext letter it gives under that key letter.
# plaintext = ALPHABET[(n - 1 + ALPHABET.index(key letter)) mod 25]; ALPHABET = ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ (I/J one letter).
# The key restarts at position 0 (W) at the start of every coded stretch; Lee's slips shift the position (key.md).
